response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT COALESCE(CENTROMEA, 'missing') AS status, AVG(GOT - GPT) AS ast_minus_alt, AVG(APTT - PT) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5 GROUP BY COALESCE(CENTROMEA, 'missing')) SELECT AVG(ast_minus_alt) AS avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_status;
